disclaimer: Curated baseline for ResumeAI. Not live job-board or salary-API data.

industries.name: Software Engineering
industries.summary: Product engineering roles that ship web and backend systems.
industries.outlookNote: Demand stays strongest for engineers who can ship full features, not only isolated tickets.
industries.hiringFocus: Production experience, TypeScript/JavaScript depth, and clear system-design examples.

industries.name: Data & AI
industries.summary: Analytics, machine learning, and applied AI roles.
industries.outlookNote: Hiring favors people who can clean data, train models, and explain results to non-technical teams.
industries.hiringFocus: Python plus a proven ML or analytics project with measurable outcomes.

industries.name: Cloud & DevOps
industries.summary: Infrastructure, cloud platforms, and delivery automation.
industries.outlookNote: Teams want engineers who can deploy reliably, not only write application code.
industries.hiringFocus: Docker/Kubernetes plus one major cloud and a CI/CD pipeline you can describe end to end.

industries.name: Mobile Engineering
industries.summary: Native and cross-platform mobile product work.
industries.outlookNote: Openings concentrate on shipped App Store / Play Store experience.
industries.hiringFocus: A public app, platform expertise (Swift or Kotlin), and API integration.

industries.name: Product & Design
industries.summary: Product thinking, UX, and interface craft.
industries.outlookNote: Roles reward portfolios that show research, iteration, and shipped UI.
industries.hiringFocus: Figma work plus evidence you collaborated with engineers and users.
